duplicateQA.baseCatalog: No matching Stockman's, Winnemucca, Model T, Winners Inn or Tonopah Station records were found in the base catalog inspection. Hotel Nevada and Prospector were likewise not found as existing active Nevada catalog records.
duplicateQA.currentNevadaPasses: These seven rural destinations are outside the currently active Nevada Pass 22 and Pass 32 sets and use distinct stable IDs and property coordinates.

holds.name: Bonanza Casino
holds.reason: Current address/identity is corroborated, but the numerical point surfaced in this pass is tied primarily to RV/campground-style mapping rather than a sufficiently strong casino/property coordinate. Do not promote merely to round out the Fallon pair.

holds.name: Red Drag Casino

nextPhase: Serialize these seven records in the next chronological catalog pass, activate them, validate green, then continue the uncleared NV-02 Clark County segments and remaining rural completeness/hold work without weakening the property-specific evidence gate.
